intro.owner: Invite the people you live with. They choose their own password and can help track expenses and goals, but only you can manage members.
intro.member: The people sharing this household. Only the owner can invite or remove members.

invite.title: Invite someone

roles.title: Roles

roles.owner: Full control: budgets, members and household settings. There is exactly one owner.
roles.editor: Can add and edit expenses, budgets and goals. Can't manage members.
roles.viewer: Read-only access, for people who only need to see where things stand.
